name: Sepulchrine-Sabkha
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past a nearby asteroid belt, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
